title: "Quantification of LysoFix Time-course"
output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Overview

This analysis calculates the staining index for the LysoFix time-course.

Analysis included shown in figure 1B

## Required packages
```{r packages}
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Load raw data
```{r load-data}
raw_data <- readxl::read_excel(
  "LysoFix Timecourse Raw Quantification.xlsx")
```

# Clean column names and prepare data
```{r tidy-headers and prep data}
names(raw_data)[-1] <- sub(
  ".*\\|\\s*(Median|Robust SD)\\s*\\(PE-A\\).*",
  "\\1",
  names(raw_data)[-1]
)

names(raw_data)[-1] <- gsub(" ", "_", names(raw_data)[-1])

data <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = sub("^[^_]*_", "", File_Name),
    Sample = gsub("\\.fcs$", "", Sample),
    Cell_Line = sub("_.*", "", Sample),
    Condition = sub("^[^_]*_", "", Sample)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Cell_Line) %>%
  select(File_Name, Sample, Cell_Line, Condition, Median, Robust_SD)
```
  
## Calculate staining index
The staining index is calculated relative to the GBA1 KO.

```{r calculate-si}
KO_Median_SD <- data %>%
  filter(Cell_Line == "GBA KO") %>%
  select(
    Condition,
    KO_Median = Median,
    KO_RobustSD = Robust_SD
  )

SI_Calc <- data %>%
  left_join(KO_Median_SD, by = "Condition") %>%
  mutate(
    Median_vs_GBAKO = Median - KO_Median,
    SI = Median_vs_GBAKO / (2 * KO_RobustSD)
  )

LysoFix_dataframe <- SI_Calc %>%
  separate(
    Condition,
    into = c("LysoFix_Conc", "LysoFix_Time"),
    sep = "_",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    LysoFix_Conc = gsub("LysoFix ", "", LysoFix_Conc),
    LysoFix_Time = gsub("hr", "", LysoFix_Time),
    LysoFix_Time = gsub("30mins", "0.5", LysoFix_Time),
    Cell_Line = factor(
      Cell_Line,
      levels = c("GBA KO", "BxB WT", "BxB N409S")
    ),
    LysoFix_Time = factor(
      LysoFix_Time,
      levels = c("0.5", "1", "2", "3", "4")
    )
  )
```

## Plot staining index
```{r plot}
CellLineColours <- c(
  "GBA KO" = "skyblue",
  "BxB WT" = "orange",
  "BxB N409S" = "green"
)

SI_15uMLysoFix <- LysoFix_dataframe %>%
  filter(str_detect(Condition, "LysoFix")) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = LysoFix_Time,
      y = SI,
      group = Cell_Line,
      color = Cell_Line
    )
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 1, position = "identity", alpha = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (hours)",
    y = "Staining Index"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = CellLineColours,
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "transparent",
      colour = NA
    ),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.1
    ),
    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "transparent",
      colour = NA
    ),
    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = "transparent",
      colour = NA
    ),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(
      color = "gray90",
      linewidth = 0.1
    ),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      color = "gray90",
      linewidth = 0.1
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.1
    ),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm"),
    axis.line = element_blank()
  )

SI_15uMLysoFix

ggsave(
  "LysoFix Timecourse Staining Index.pdf",
  plot = SI_15uMLysoFix,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  width = 37,
  height = 32,
  units = "mm"
)
```
